title: FIFA Predictor Design System
intro: A sports-oriented and competitive visual language with an immersive dark mode, modern typography, and vibrant accents to simulate the stadium environment.

primary.name: Indigo
primary.usage: Primary brand color. Headers, key navigation accents, and main buttons

secondary.name: Neon Green
secondary.usage: Competitive accent color. Accurate score predictions, status check indicators, and active CTAs

gold.name: Gold
gold.usage: Leader highlight in the leaderboard and trophy rewards

card.name: Card Slate
card.usage: Match card blocks and prediction containers

textMuted.name: Text Gray
textMuted.usage: Secondary labels, match dates, and locked prediction state descriptions

success.name: Success
success.usage: Maximum score achieved (+3 points for exact score)

hierarchy.name: Display Title
hierarchy.usage: Main tournament headers and featured screens

hierarchy.name: Card Heading
hierarchy.usage: Country names in the match card blocks

hierarchy.name: Body Text
hierarchy.usage: General text, leaderboard rows, and automated bot roasts

hierarchy.name: Score Value
hierarchy.usage: Match numeric scores and user accumulated points
